# Python reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Reading data

Every reader returns the same container, so nothing downstream can tell which format the data arrived in.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [read](read.qmd#falconage.read) | Dispatch on the filename. Convenience, not magic -- it says what it chose. |
| [read_betas](read_betas.qmd#falconage.read_betas) | Read a beta matrix from CSV, TSV or parquet. |
| [read_series_matrix](read_series_matrix.qmd#falconage.read_series_matrix) | Read a GEO ``*_series_matrix.txt.gz``: metadata and betas in one file. |
| [read_clinical](read_clinical.qmd#falconage.read_clinical) | Read a clinical chemistry table. |
| [read_rrbs_dir](read_rrbs_dir.qmd#falconage.read_rrbs_dir) | Assemble several RRBS files into one matrix on their shared sites. |
| [read_bedmethyl](read_bedmethyl.qmd#falconage.read_bedmethyl) | One nanopore bedMethyl file as a per-site methylation fraction. |
| [read_bedmethyl_dir](read_bedmethyl_dir.qmd#falconage.read_bedmethyl_dir) | Several bedMethyl files as one matrix on their shared sites. |
| [read_panel](read_panel.qmd#falconage.read_panel) | A targeted assay: pyrosequencing, EpiTYPER, amplicon, ddPCR. |
| [read_computage_bench](read_computage_bench.qmd#falconage.read_computage_bench) | One ComputAgeBench study, ready to score. |
| [list_computage_bench](list_computage_bench.qmd#falconage.list_computage_bench) | What is in the benchmark: one row per study. |
| [preprocess.read_olink](preprocess.read_olink.qmd#falconage.preprocess.read_olink) | An Olink NPX matrix: samples x proteins, values already log2. |
| [preprocess.read_somascan](preprocess.read_somascan.qmd#falconage.preprocess.read_somascan) | A SomaScan RFU matrix. |
| [preprocess.read_counts](preprocess.read_counts.qmd#falconage.preprocess.read_counts) | A bulk RNA-seq count matrix. |
| [FalconData](FalconData.qmd#falconage.FalconData) | A scoreable dataset. |

## Raw arrays

IDAT to scoreable betas, which until v1.1 meant leaving FALCONAge for sesame or minfi and coming back. The manifest is fetched from Illumina's public bucket and cached; it is the one step here that is not offline. Detection is computed before background correction, because pOOBAH's null is the uncorrected out-of-band signal.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [idat_to_betas](idat_to_betas.qmd#falconage.idat_to_betas) | One Grn/Red IDAT pair to a beta vector, through the full chain. |
| [read_idat_dir](read_idat_dir.qmd#falconage.read_idat_dir) | Every Grn/Red pair in a directory, as one scoreable matrix. |
| [preprocess.poobah](preprocess.poobah.qmd#falconage.preprocess.poobah) | Detection p-values against the out-of-band background (Zhou 2018). |
| [preprocess.noob](preprocess.noob.qmd#falconage.preprocess.noob) | Normal-exponential background correction using the out-of-band signal. |
| [preprocess.dye_bias](preprocess.dye_bias.qmd#falconage.preprocess.dye_bias) | Equalise the two colour channels. **Off by default -- see the warning.** |
| [preprocess.bmiq](preprocess.bmiq.qmd#falconage.preprocess.bmiq) | BMIQ: put type II probes on the type I scale. |
| [preprocess.RawSignal](preprocess.RawSignal.qmd#falconage.preprocess.RawSignal) | One sample's in-band and out-of-band intensities, probe by probe. |
| [preprocess.load_manifest](preprocess.load_manifest.qmd#falconage.preprocess.load_manifest) | Address-to-probe mapping for one platform, indexed by probe id. |
| [preprocess.manifest_record](preprocess.manifest_record.qmd#falconage.preprocess.manifest_record) | What the run manifest records about the mapping that produced a beta. |
| [preprocess.load_mask](preprocess.load_mask.qmd#falconage.preprocess.load_mask) | The published mask for one platform, indexed by probe. |
| [preprocess.mask_report](preprocess.mask_report.qmd#falconage.preprocess.mask_report) | What applying this mask would cost each clock. |
| [preprocess.apply_mask](preprocess.apply_mask.qmd#falconage.preprocess.apply_mask) | Set masked probes to NaN. Not called anywhere automatically. |

## Preprocessing

Getting a matrix into the shape every clock assumes: bare probe identifiers, values in the beta range, a known platform. The EPIC v2 step is mandatory rather than optional -- without it a v2 dataset overlaps almost nothing and the clocks score imputed values.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [prepare](prepare.qmd#falconage.prepare) | The standard chain: harmonise ids, collapse v2 replicates, clip, identify. |
| [prepare_clinical](prepare_clinical.qmd#falconage.prepare_clinical) | Rename to canonical markers and convert to the units the models expect. |
| [qc](qc.qmd#falconage.qc) | Look at the data before scoring it. |
| [probe_loss](probe_loss.qmd#falconage.probe_loss) | What each clock has lost on this dataset, before scoring anything. |
| [preprocess.aggregate_replicate_probes](preprocess.aggregate_replicate_probes.qmd#falconage.preprocess.aggregate_replicate_probes) | Strip EPIC v2 probe suffixes and collapse the replicates. |
| [preprocess.impute](preprocess.impute.qmd#falconage.preprocess.impute) | Dataset-level imputation, applied before any clock sees the matrix. |
| [fit_batch_reference](fit_batch_reference.qmd#falconage.fit_batch_reference) | Fit the frozen global parameters on a reference cohort. |
| [apply_batch_reference](apply_batch_reference.qmd#falconage.apply_batch_reference) | Correct a dataset against frozen parameters, one batch at a time. |
| [preprocess.BatchReference](preprocess.BatchReference.qmd#falconage.preprocess.BatchReference) | Frozen global parameters. The artefact that makes results stable. |
| [preprocess.prepare_proteomic](preprocess.prepare_proteomic.qmd#falconage.preprocess.prepare_proteomic) | Put a proteomic matrix on the scale a clock's coefficients expect. |
| [preprocess.prepare_transcriptomic](preprocess.prepare_transcriptomic.qmd#falconage.preprocess.prepare_transcriptomic) | Run the whole chain, in order, recording each step. |
| [preprocess.rle_normalise](preprocess.rle_normalise.qmd#falconage.preprocess.rle_normalise) | Median-of-ratios size factors (DESeq's RLE). |
| [preprocess.yugene](preprocess.yugene.qmd#falconage.preprocess.yugene) | The YuGene cumulative-proportion transform, per sample. |
| [preprocess.median_centre](preprocess.median_centre.qmd#falconage.preprocess.median_centre) | Subtract each gene's median across the samples given. |

## Uncertainty

How much of a score is the assay, and how far it is likely to be from the truth. Two different questions with two different answers, kept apart on purpose: technical replicates of the same DNA differ by up to nine years on prominent clocks, and a point estimate says nothing about either.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [technical_se](technical_se.qmd#falconage.technical_se) | Standard error on each score attributable to assay measurement noise. |
| [interval](interval.qmd#falconage.interval) | Score, lower and upper bound, long form. |
| [conformal_interval](conformal_interval.qmd#falconage.conformal_interval) | How far the prediction is likely to be from chronological age. |
| [icc_from_replicates](icc_from_replicates.qmd#falconage.icc_from_replicates) | Per-probe ICC(1,1) computed from the user's own technical replicates. |
| [uncertainty.load_probe_icc](uncertainty.load_probe_icc.qmd#falconage.uncertainty.load_probe_icc) | Per-probe test-retest ICC, indexed by feature id. |
| [uncertainty.probe_icc_source](uncertainty.probe_icc_source.qmd#falconage.uncertainty.probe_icc_source) | Provenance of the bundled table, for the run manifest. |
| [uncertainty.load_conformal](uncertainty.load_conformal.qmd#falconage.uncertainty.load_conformal) | Calibrated prediction-interval half-widths, one row per clock and level. |

## Study design

The commands that come before the first array and after the last one. How many samples an effect needs, given the clock's own reliability; and whether a difference that turned up survives the multi-clock rule that a re-analysis of six intervention datasets says it must.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [power](power.qmd#falconage.power) | How many samples to see an effect of this size on this clock. |
| [detectable_effect](detectable_effect.qmd#falconage.detectable_effect) | The smallest effect a given n can see. The inverse of :func:`power`. |
| [consensus](consensus.qmd#falconage.consensus) | Does a group difference hold up across clocks, or is it one clock? |
| [registry.evidence](registry.evidence.qmd#falconage.registry.evidence) | What a score on this clock has been shown to predict, and how strongly. |

| [FalconResult](FalconResult.qmd#falconage.FalconResult) | Scores plus everything needed to say where they came from. |

## The clock catalogue

161 clocks in three availability tiers. Twenty-eight are scaffolds whose coefficients are research-use-only; the registry says which, why, and what open clock answers the same question.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [registry.load](registry.load.qmd#falconage.registry.load) | Load the packaged registry. Cached for the life of the process. |
| [registry.ClockRegistry](registry.ClockRegistry.qmd#falconage.registry.ClockRegistry) | Loaded catalogue. Immutable except for user-registered local weights. |
| [registry.Clock](registry.Clock.qmd#falconage.registry.Clock) | One registry entry. |
| [registry.register_local_weights](registry.register_local_weights.qmd#falconage.registry.register_local_weights) | Supply a coefficient file for a clock FALCONAge does not distribute. |

## Analysis

Age acceleration in its three conventions, association and survival models, reliability, and the AA1/AA2 benchmark. Each is gated on the clock's scale type -- acceleration on a pace-of-aging clock is a units error, not a conservative choice.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [acceleration](acceleration.qmd#falconage.acceleration) | Age acceleration, in whichever of the three conventions you mean. |
| [cell_composition](cell_composition.qmd#falconage.cell_composition) | Cell-type proportions estimated in this same run, as a covariate frame. |
| [associate](associate.qmd#falconage.associate) | Ordinary least squares of each clock on an outcome, adjusted for covariates. |
| [cox_hazard](cox_hazard.qmd#falconage.cox_hazard) | Univariable Cox hazard ratio per clock, by Breslow-tied partial likelihood. |
| [agreement](agreement.qmd#falconage.agreement) | Between-clock correlation. |
| [icc](icc.qmd#falconage.icc) | ICC(2,1): two-way random effects, absolute agreement, single measure. |
| [run_benchmark](run_benchmark.qmd#falconage.run_benchmark) | The AA1 and AA2 tests, and the score that combines them. |

## Clinical references

KDM and homeostatic dysregulation have no fixed coefficients: both are defined relative to a reference cohort, and the manifest records which.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [models.fit_kdm](models.fit_kdm.qmd#falconage.models.fit_kdm) | Fit the KDM reference regressions. |
| [models.fit_hd](models.fit_hd.qmd#falconage.models.fit_hd) | Estimate the healthy reference centre and covariance. |
| [models.clinical.phenoage](models.clinical.phenoage.qmd#falconage.models.clinical.phenoage) | Clinical Phenotypic Age in years. |

## Model architectures

Not every clock is a dot product. Six summarise a probe set with a mean or a percentile; the principal-component and neural families need a weight file no licence permits redistributing; scAge asks a different question entirely, one age per cell from a methylome that is 99% missing. All of these are implemented and tested against synthetic weights, and all of them work the day a user supplies a file.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [models.AggregationClock](models.AggregationClock.qmd#falconage.models.AggregationClock) | ``postprocess(statistic(X[features]))``. |
| [models.NeuralClock](models.NeuralClock.qmd#falconage.models.NeuralClock) | A feed-forward network over a fixed probe set. |
| [models.read_neural_weights](models.read_neural_weights.qmd#falconage.models.read_neural_weights) | Load layer weights from a ``.safetensors`` file. |
| [models.PCLinearClock](models.PCLinearClock.qmd#falconage.models.PCLinearClock) | ``postprocess(((x - centre) @ rotation) @ pc_coefficients)``. |
| [models.read_rotation](models.read_rotation.qmd#falconage.models.read_rotation) | Load a rotation from ``.npz``. |
| [models.ScAgeReference](models.ScAgeReference.qmd#falconage.models.ScAgeReference) | Per-CpG linear models of bulk methylation on age. |
| [models.fit_scage_reference](models.fit_scage_reference.qmd#falconage.models.fit_scage_reference) | Fit the per-CpG age models on a bulk reference cohort. |
| [models.scage](models.scage.qmd#falconage.models.scage) | An age per cell, by profile likelihood over a grid of candidate ages. |

## Figures and reports

Every plot returns its data as well as its figure, which is how the two languages draw the same numbers with different engines. `clock_atlas` is the exception in scale rather than in kind: one figure covering every clock across every pooled study, for the case where a per-clock panel would need forty of them.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [plot.ba_vs_ca](plot.ba_vs_ca.qmd#falconage.plot.ba_vs_ca) | Predicted against chronological age, with the identity line. |
| [plot.bland_altman](plot.bland_altman.qmd#falconage.plot.bland_altman) | Difference against mean, with bias and 95% limits of agreement. |
| [plot.calibration](plot.calibration.qmd#falconage.plot.calibration) | Residual against chronological age. |
| [plot.acceleration_density](plot.acceleration_density.qmd#falconage.plot.acceleration_density) | Histogram of acceleration, optionally split by group. |
| [plot.acceleration_by_group](plot.acceleration_by_group.qmd#falconage.plot.acceleration_by_group) | Box and strip of acceleration by group -- the case/control workhorse. |
| [plot.acceleration_heatmap](plot.acceleration_heatmap.qmd#falconage.plot.acceleration_heatmap) | Clocks by samples, z-scored within clock. |
| [plot.forest](plot.forest.qmd#falconage.plot.forest) | Effect size and 95% interval per clock/dataset comparison. |
| [plot.kaplan_meier](plot.kaplan_meier.qmd#falconage.plot.kaplan_meier) | Survival of the fastest-ageing tail against the slowest. |
| [plot.volcano](plot.volcano.qmd#falconage.plot.volcano) | Effect size against evidence, for a table from :func:`~falconage.associate`. |
| [plot.clock_corr](plot.clock_corr.qmd#falconage.plot.clock_corr) | Correlation heatmap, hierarchically ordered. |
| [plot.clock_radar](plot.clock_radar.qmd#falconage.plot.clock_radar) | Closed-polygon profile across clocks, one polygon per group. |
| [plot.clock_chord](plot.clock_chord.qmd#falconage.plot.clock_chord) | Circos-style chord diagram of CpG sharing between clocks. |
| [plot.clock_pca](plot.clock_pca.qmd#falconage.plot.clock_pca) | Samples embedded in clock space. |
| [plot.clock_atlas](plot.clock_atlas.qmd#falconage.plot.clock_atlas) | One figure comparing every clock across every pooled study. |
| [plot.coverage_bar](plot.coverage_bar.qmd#falconage.plot.coverage_bar) | Per-clock feature coverage. The plot to read before the scores. |
| [plot.missingness](plot.missingness.qmd#falconage.plot.missingness) | Distribution of per-sample missingness. |
| [plot.beta_density](plot.beta_density.qmd#falconage.plot.beta_density) | Per-sample beta distribution. |
| [plot.platform_comparison](plot.platform_comparison.qmd#falconage.plot.platform_comparison) | Score distribution split by array platform. |
| [plot.study_comparison](plot.study_comparison.qmd#falconage.plot.study_comparison) | Score distribution split by study. |
| [plot.benchmark_bars](plot.benchmark_bars.qmd#falconage.plot.benchmark_bars) | AA2 and AA1 counts per clock, ordered by the combined total. |
| [plot.benchmark_error_bias](plot.benchmark_error_bias.qmd#falconage.plot.benchmark_error_bias) | MedAE against MedE, sized by the benchmark total. |
| [plot.benchmark_heatmap](plot.benchmark_heatmap.qmd#falconage.plot.benchmark_heatmap) | Effect size per clock and dataset, with significant cells outlined. |
| [plot.reliability_forest](plot.reliability_forest.qmd#falconage.plot.reliability_forest) | Technical standard error per clock, with the ICC that cohort implies. |
| [plot.score_interval](plot.score_interval.qmd#falconage.plot.score_interval) | One clock's scores with their intervals, sample by sample. |
| [plot.platform_bias](plot.platform_bias.qmd#falconage.plot.platform_bias) | What probe loss costs each clock, in years, on each platform. |
| [plot.consensus_plot](plot.consensus_plot.qmd#falconage.plot.consensus_plot) | The multi-clock verdict, drawn. |
| [plot.palette](plot.palette.qmd#falconage.plot.palette) |  |
| [plot.save_all](plot.save_all.qmd#falconage.plot.save_all) | Render every figure this result can support and write it as PNG. |
| [report.write_report](report.write_report.qmd#falconage.report.write_report) | Render one self-contained HTML file for a scoring run. |

## Downloading public data

Accession in, files and a normalised sample table out. Credentialed archives are documented rather than automated -- the access agreement is the user's, not the tool's.

| --- | --- |
| [download](download.qmd#falconage.download) | Fetch public data from an accession. |

| [download.clear_cache](download.clear_cache.qmd#falconage.download.clear_cache) | Delete the download cache. Returns the bytes freed. |
